subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelled word:

"The scientist emphasized that the ______ effects of small daily habits can significantly influence long-term health outcomes."
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. cumulative .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "cumulative" is correctly spelled and represents something that increases or builds up over time by accumulation.
 
• All other options (1, 2, and 4) are misspelled forms of the word "cumulative."
 
• The correct sentence reads: *"The scientist emphasized that the **cumulative** effects of small daily habits can significantly influence long-term health outcomes."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word "cumulative" is derived from the Latin word "cumulare," meaning "to heap up."
 
• It is often used in contexts relating to the accumulation of effects, data, or results over time.
 
• For example:
 
 
• The cumulative rainfall this year exceeded last year's levels.
 
• Her cumulative efforts over the semester earned her a high grade.
